assistance_resources_content_or_url_chec.name: assistance_resources_content_or_url_check
assistance_resources_content_or_url_chec.value: "assistance_resources"."content_body" IS NOT NULL OR "assistance_resources"."external_url" IS NOT NULL

cde_transition_events_states_check.name: cde_transition_events_states_check
cde_transition_events_states_check.value: "cde_transition_events"."from_state" in ('WIP', 'SHARED', 'PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED') AND ("cde_transition_events"."to_state" IS NULL OR "cde_transition_events"."to_state" in ('WIP', 'SHARED', 'PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED'))

documents_archive_consistency_check.name: documents_archive_consistency_check
documents_archive_consistency_check.value: ("documents"."status" = 'archived' AND "documents"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("documents"."status" != 'archived' AND "documents"."archived_at" IS NULL)

final_accounts_seal_check.name: final_accounts_seal_check
final_accounts_seal_check.value: ("final_accounts"."status" = 'sealed' AND "final_accounts"."sealed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("final_accounts"."status" <> 'sealed' AND "final_accounts"."sealed_at" IS NULL)

plans_feature_limits_nonnegative.name: plans_feature_limits_nonnegative
plans_feature_limits_nonnegative.value: coalesce("plans"."monthly_ai_limit", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("plans"."monthly_pdf_limit", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("plans"."monthly_crm_limit", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("plans"."monthly_regulation_limit", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("plans"."monthly_profit_analysis_limit", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("plans"."storage_max_bytes", 1) > 0 AND coalesce("plans"."max_documents", 1) > 0

price_snapshots_validity_check.name: price_snapshots_validity_check
price_snapshots_validity_check.value: "price_snapshots"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "price_snapshots"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "price_snapshots"."valid_until" >= "price_snapshots"."valid_from"

price_sources_authorization_evidence_che.name: price_sources_authorization_evidence_check
price_sources_authorization_evidence_che.value: "price_sources"."authorization_status" <> 'authorized' OR ("price_sources"."authorization_evidence_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND length("price_sources"."authorization_scope") > 0 AND "price_sources"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "price_sources"."authorized_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

pricing_data_sources_authorization_evide.name: pricing_data_sources_authorization_evidence_check
pricing_data_sources_authorization_evide.value: "pricing_data_sources"."authorization_status" <> 'authorized' OR ("pricing_data_sources"."authorization_evidence_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND length("pricing_data_sources"."authorization_scope") > 0 AND "pricing_data_sources"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL)

progress_measurements_source_binding_che.name: progress_measurements_source_binding_check
progress_measurements_source_binding_che.value:
("progress_measurements"."source_type" = 'manual' AND "progress_measurements"."source_document_id" IS NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_processing_run_id" IS NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_quantity_row_id" IS NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_cell_range" IS NULL)
    OR ("progress_measurements"."source_type" in ('ifc','xlsx') AND "progress_measurements"."source_document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_processing_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_quantity_row_id" IS NOT NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_cell_range" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("progress_measurements"."source_type" in ('pdf','field_record') AND "progress_measurements"."source_document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_processing_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_quantity_row_id" IS NULL AND "progress_measurements"."source_cell_range" IS NOT NULL)

progress_measurements_review_binding_che.name: progress_measurements_review_binding_check
progress_measurements_review_binding_che.value:
("progress_measurements"."review_status" = 'pending_review' AND "progress_measurements"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "progress_measurements"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "progress_measurements"."review_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("progress_measurements"."review_status" in ('approved','rejected') AND "progress_measurements"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "progress_measurements"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("progress_measurements"."review_reason")) > 0)
    OR "progress_measurements"."review_status" = 'superseded'

progress_payment_events_status_check.name: progress_payment_events_status_check
progress_payment_events_status_check.value:
("progress_payment_events"."action"='submit' AND "progress_payment_events"."from_status"='draft' AND "progress_payment_events"."to_status"='submitted')
    OR ("progress_payment_events"."action"='approve' AND "progress_payment_events"."from_status"='submitted' AND "progress_payment_events"."to_status"='approved')
    OR ("progress_payment_events"."action"='reject' AND "progress_payment_events"."from_status"='submitted' AND "progress_payment_events"."to_status"='draft')
    OR ("progress_payment_events"."action"='cancel' AND "progress_payment_events"."from_status" in ('draft','submitted') AND "progress_payment_events"."to_status"='cancelled')
    OR ("progress_payment_events"."action"='correct' AND "progress_payment_events"."from_status"='approved' AND "progress_payment_events"."to_status"='superseded')

regulation_versions_validity_check.name: regulation_versions_validity_check
regulation_versions_validity_check.value: "regulation_versions"."effective_until" IS NULL OR "regulation_versions"."effective_from" IS NULL OR "regulation_versions"."effective_until" >= "regulation_versions"."effective_from"

rule_registry_scope_consistency_check.name: rule_registry_scope_consistency_check
rule_registry_scope_consistency_check.value: ("rule_registry"."scope" = 'quotation' AND "rule_registry"."quotation_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("rule_registry"."scope" = 'company' AND "rule_registry"."quotation_id" IS NULL)

smartcheck_pilot_measurements_non_negati.name: smartcheck_pilot_measurements_non_negative_check
smartcheck_pilot_measurements_non_negati.value: "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."total_rows" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."parsed_rows" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."manually_corrected_rows" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."finding_count" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."approved_rows" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."transferred_rows" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."provenance_complete_rows" >= 0

smartcheck_pilot_measurements_rate_check.name: smartcheck_pilot_measurements_rate_check
smartcheck_pilot_measurements_rate_check.value: ("smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."parse_rate" IS NULL OR ("smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."parse_rate" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."parse_rate" <= 1)) AND ("smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."manual_reentry_free_rate" IS NULL OR ("smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."manual_reentry_free_rate" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."manual_reentry_free_rate" <= 1)) AND ("smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."provenance_coverage" IS NULL OR ("smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."provenance_coverage" >= 0 AND "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."provenance_coverage" <= 1))

smartcheck_pilot_measurements_duration_c.name: smartcheck_pilot_measurements_duration_check
smartcheck_pilot_measurements_duration_c.value: ("smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."processing_duration_seconds" IS NULL OR "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."processing_duration_seconds" >= 0) AND ("smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."workflow_duration_seconds" IS NULL OR "smartcheck_pilot_measurements"."workflow_duration_seconds" >= 0)

supplier_quote_entries_validity_check.name: supplier_quote_entries_validity_check
supplier_quote_entries_validity_check.value: "supplier_quote_entries"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "supplier_quote_entries"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "supplier_quote_entries"."valid_until" >= "supplier_quote_entries"."valid_from"

supplier_quote_submissions_validity_chec.name: supplier_quote_submissions_validity_check
supplier_quote_submissions_validity_chec.value: "supplier_quote_submissions"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "supplier_quote_submissions"."quote_date" IS NULL OR "supplier_quote_submissions"."valid_until" >= "supplier_quote_submissions"."quote_date"
